# `non-idiomatic-name`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: official · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports declarations that do not follow Zig's function, type, or variable naming
conventions.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Consistent casing communicates a declaration's role before its type is inspected
and keeps APIs familiar to Zig readers.

## When it fires

It skips exported, extern, escaped, and uncertain declarations where renaming
could affect an external contract.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn Compute_total() void {}
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#Names>
